payload.title: A site turns personas on and keeps a list of them
payload.description:
A site setting, off by default, turns personas on. A persona record holds: name, slug, short public bio, persistent instructions, voice notes, enabled. Stored as versioned backend data like the guidelines documents, edited with a papyrus personas CLI and an Administration panel (hidden while the setting is off). Turning personas on replaces the byline policy's pen-names list: a site with personas signs with persona names; converting an existing pen-names policy creates one persona per name.
Scenario: a site without personas sees nothing new. Scenario: an editor creates, edits and disables a persona; a disabled persona is never offered for new Stories but stays on the Stories it signed.
